tools.name: pool_candles
tools.description: Price candles (OHLC and swap volume) for any Uniswap v3 pool on Base, computed from on-chain Swap logs: open, high, low, close per 1-60 minute bucket over the last 100-5000 blocks, with token addresses and decimals (pool=0x..., interval=5, blocks=2000; default WETH/USDC). For trading and market-maki
